changes: neronet_native_host.exe: the locator reads offsets and registers from QQ's code instead of fixed values; Core backend rules that do not resolve keep the legacy result; deterministic identification failures are remembered per QQ file and rule set (discovery.failed); the identification cache root is the one the supervisor passes (NERONET_BINDING_CACHE)

neronet_live_binding.dll: QQ start-up states are waited out instead of refused; a QQ executor that is busy fails only that request (NERONET_EXECUTOR_BUSY) instead of ending the session; the release command list has the commands of the 2.1 actions (the one-way friend list under QQ's name MQUpdateSvc_com_qq_ti.web.OidbSvc.0xe17_0)
